concerns.text: No task exercises `code/utils/update_state.py` (plan Phase 3.4 'State Update: hashes artifacts and updates state/...yaml'; Constitution Principle V). T101–T111 never run or verify the state-hash update, so this plan element and constitution requirement has no implementing task.

data-model.md mandates a `selection_bias_stats` object (KS-test results) populated in `aligned_dataset.npz` 'before training begins'. T104 only mentions a 'selection-bias flag' in evaluation metadata; no task produces or validates `selection_bias_stats` in the npz, leaving this data-model invariant uncovered.

T104 requires evaluation_metrics.json to contain paired t-test p-values (SC-003 p<0.01 check), but the contract's metric_block (additionalProperties: false) defines only mae/r2/tost_p_value/ci_lower/ci_upper. T103/T104's schema-validation check will fail against a t-test-compliant output; the tasks list has no task to reconcile the contract with the required t-test fields.
